name: botsim-poc
description: Browser combat robot sim (MuJoCo WASM + Three.js) with STEP import and a robot gallery

scripts.test: rolldown tests/headless.ts --format esm --platform node --external @mujoco/mujoco --file tests/.out/headless.mjs && node tests/.out/headless.mjs
scripts.test:import: rolldown tests/import_frog.ts --format esm --platform node --external @mujoco/mujoco --file tests/.out/import.mjs && node tests/.out/import.mjs
scripts.validate: rolldown tests/validate_robots.ts --format esm --platform node --external @mujoco/mujoco --file tests/.out/validate.mjs && node tests/.out/validate.mjs
scripts.stress: rolldown tests/stress.ts --format esm --platform node --external @mujoco/mujoco --file tests/.out/stress.mjs && node tests/.out/stress.mjs
scripts.fuzz: rolldown tests/fuzz.ts --format esm --platform node --external @mujoco/mujoco --file tests/.out/fuzz.mjs && node tests/.out/fuzz.mjs
